findings.summary: A window resize (ProductModel.resize) leaves the host-terminal kill confirmation open; the test packet lists resize among the inputs that cancel it. Safe either way: resize never confirms and nothing reaches a pane (green test); a later k still confirms. Same behaviour as the command menu. Red test: tests/ui/test_product_shell_kill_independent_p27s.py:169. Fix: close kill_confirm_open (and notice) in resize(), or Root decides resize is not a cancel and the red test is dropped.
